messages.subject: Quartz — draft disclosure letter for your review
messages.plaintextBody:
Alice, Sanjay, Priya,

The draft disclosure letter is ready for your review (in the data room, folder 0). Please check the specific disclosures carefully — particularly the IP, tax (R&D claim), grant and disputes sections — as the warranties are given against what's disclosed here. Accuracy protects you.

Please send any corrections by Friday. We'll then circulate to Hargrove.

Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
